name: Nigeria

instruments.name: Nigeria Data Protection Regulation (NDPR) 2019 and its Implementation Framework
CBN consumer protection and risk-based cybersecurity frameworks

facet_hints.registration: The NDPA introduces registration of data controllers and processors of major importance; confirm the current threshold, the registration window, and the filing route with the NDPC.
facet_hints.audit_filing: The NDPR regime required an annual data protection audit filing through a licensed Data Protection Compliance Organisation (DPCO); confirm what survives under the NDPA and who must file.
facet_hints.personal_data: Confirm the NDPA's lawful bases and principles, and how they differ from the earlier NDPR.
facet_hints.special_categories: Sensitive personal data under the NDPA; note that NIN and BVN are high-sensitivity national identifiers in practice.
facet_hints.cross_border: Confirm the NDPA's conditions for cross-border transfer, including adequacy-style assessment and the permitted derogations.
facet_hints.breach_notification: Confirm the NDPA breach notification duty: to the Commission, to data subjects, and the period allowed.
facet_hints.dpo: Confirm when a data protection officer must be designated.
facet_hints.enforcement: Search NDPC enforcement actions, remedial fees and published investigations, including those against banks and fintechs.

seed_obligations.provision: Registration of data controllers and processors of major importance
seed_obligations.title: Register with the NDPC if you are a controller of major importance
applies_when: processes personal data of Nigerian data subjects above the threshold set by the Commission
testable_as: a record of the threshold assessment that concluded registration was or was not required

seed_obligations.title: Establish and record a lawful basis for each processing purpose
testable_as: consent records where consent is the basis

seed_obligations.title: Notify the Commission, and affected subjects, of a qualifying breach
testable_as: an incident runbook naming the Commission and the deadline
a path from detection to notification that a person owns

seed_obligations.title: Meet the conditions for transferring personal data out of Nigeria
applies_when: a foreign inference or hosting vendor receives personal data
testable_as: a recorded transfer basis per destination
a DPA with each foreign processor

seed_obligations.title: Designate a data protection officer where required
applies_when: large-scale processing of sensitive personal data
testable_as: a named DPO with published contact details

seed_obligations.title: Treat NIN and BVN as high-sensitivity national identifiers
applies_when: stores or transmits a NIN or BVN

notes: Nigeria is a launch-depth pack. The NDPA 2023 superseded much of the NDPR regime but the implementation framework matters in practice; retrieval must establish the position in force today.
